readiness.override: Explicit loopback127.0.0.1 HTTP fixture only; no bypass flag

owningGate.command: bash scripts/agent-tests.sh duet test/public-cli-release.test.ts test/stage-syncthing-packages.test.ts test/public-pack.test.ts

negativeControls: Omitting readiness published to local fixture and made stale API test red
Missing release revision control failed with explicit diagnostic before PUT
Obsolete stock --publish flag acquired a binary before rename/guard, now fails before acquisition
limitations: Full native gate preceded narrow identity projection; final maintained15-case publisher gate follows projection
No actual registry release, old-writer retirement, credentials migration or duetfs registry deprecation
